Presenting Waqt Ki Baatein from The Dream Tour, 2022
This is a special one and we want to dedicate this to everyone who's been a part of this tour!
Listen to Waqt Ki Baatein on all audio streaming platforms :-
"Waqt Ki Baatein” by Dream Note is an original song exploring conversation with time about the people it quietly took away.
Dream Note is a music duo led by Gaurav Tiwari (Singer-Songwriter) and Taresh Agarwal (Guitarist and Music Producer) crafting original Hindi and indie music rooted in emotion, storytelling, and immersive sound.
A quiet acceptance of what will never come back..
